heading: Today
text: Any early sun east giving way to clouds.  Showers in NY and the St. Lawrence spreading east this morning, fewer south, and decreasing west to east this afternoon, with breaks of sun west.  Highs in the 60s.  South to southwest winds 10 to 15 mph east, and 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 35 mph from the Green Mountains west.

heading: Tonight
text: Scattered evening showers north, and in southern NH late, followed by some partial clearing, and some patches of fog.  Mild. Lows in the upper 40s to low 50s.  Southwest winds near 10 mph, shifting to the northwest and becoming light.

heading: Friday
text: Some patchy morning fog. Clouds, with a few breaks of sun.  A chance of showers in southern NH, rain possible in the afternoon.  Highs in the 60s, a few upper 50s in the Adirondacks.  Light winds, mainly north less than 10 mph.
